question: Which team won the 2025 NBA championship, and who was the Finals MVP?
text: The **Oklahoma City Thunder** won the 2025 NBA championship, defeating the Indiana Pacers 103–91 in Game 7 on June 22, 2025. Thunder guard **Shai Gilgeous-Alexander** was named Finals MVP. ([nba.com](https://www.nba.com/game/-vs--0042400407?utm_source=openai))
